caption: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, a halved soft-boiled egg, nori, and green onions. Served in a white bowl with a spoon, it rests on a dark surface under warm, focused lighting.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and smooth texture, slightly reflective under ambient light.
The chashu pork displays a tender, marbled texture with pinkish-red meat and a glistening, slightly crispy surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, triangular, with a glossy surface and visible vein-like patterns.
The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, clear, and glossy, cradling pale noodles and garnishes in a smooth, reflective surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, sliced, slightly curled pieces with visible fibrous texture and faint green tips.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk with a glossy surface, surrounded by a pale, firm white.
White ceramic bowl with glossy finish, featuring a black stylized mark and smooth, slightly curved rim.
A white ceramic spoon with a smooth surface, rounded handle, and small hole near the top.
